title: Pure tensor coordinates and extensionality of the strict tensor augmentation
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell and an arbitrary scheme T in the same universe. Use the actual completed coefficient sheaf R_T of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the ordinary signed direct-sum total tensor of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], and the actual finite tensor tower and its Roos complex of [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. The quotient completion unit is natural. Whiskering it by ordinary total tensor and composing with the normalized tensor tower isomorphism gives a natural transformation from ordinary total tensor to the completed strict tensor complex. On a pure generator x tensor y in bidegree (p,q), its nth product coordinate is (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y), with the actual finite scalar-extension unit sections and total-summand inclusion. Its shifted coordinate is identically zero. Furthermore, morphisms from each degree of ordinary total tensor are determined by their values on pure total tensor generators, and, in any abelian category, morphisms into a mapping cocone are determined by both strict coordinates. No constructibility, flatness, completeness or invertibility assumption on ell on T is required.

source.place: The tensor-product operation in the proof, specialized to the strict quotient completion augmentation; the representative formula of def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports.

proof.text: Project the product-coordinate identity for tensorOperationUnit to its nth factor. The slice augmentation sends a section z to the finite scalar-extension generator 1 tensor z. The normalized tensorTowerIso sends 1 tensor (x tensor y) to (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y). These two formulas give the required pure-total-tensor equation. The second-coordinate identity for tensorOperationUnit says that its shifted coordinate is zero in every degree.

For an arbitrary target sheaf H, the universal property of the direct-sum total tensor reduces equality of degree-k morphisms to equality on each tensor summand. The sheafification adjunction and tensor-product generation reduce equality on that summand to values on pure local sections. This is the pure_hom_ext lemma in lem-sfb-scalar-ordinary-tensor-comparison. Use the fixed-size sheafification instances of lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated so coefficient universes are fully determined.

For any abelian category and chain map phi, the mapping-cocone identity in degree i is the sum of the first projection followed by its inclusion and the shifted second projection followed by its inclusion. Postcompose this identity with each source morphism. Equality of both coordinates makes the two sums equal, hence the two morphisms equal in every degree. Chain-map extensionality finishes.

theorem coordinates (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E T) ℤ)
        (p q : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        ((((map l E T).app (P, Q)).f (p + q) ≫
          (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
            (towerTransitionEndomorphism
              (K := fun j ↦ ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor.{u, u} l E T).obj
                (P, Q)).obj (op j))
              (integralOperationsTowerStep
                ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor.{u, u} l E T).obj (P, Q))))).f (p + q) ≫
          (Pi.π (fun j ↦ ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor.{u, u} l E T).obj
            (P, Q)).obj (op j)) n).f (p + q)).val.app U)
            (@coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} T.ProEt _ (ProEt.topology T)
      (integralOperationsAbSheafify.{u, u} T)
      (integralOperationsAbLocallyBijective.{u, u} T)
              (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T) P Q p q (p + q) rfl U x y) =
          integralOperationsTotalTensorSection.{u, u} l E T n P Q p q U
            (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection.{u, u} l E T n (P.X p) U 1 x)
            (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection.{u, u} l E T n (Q.X q) U 1 y)) ∧
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules.{u, u} l E T) ℤ) (i : ℤ),
        ((map l E T).app (P, Q)).f i ≫
          (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
            (towerTransitionEndomorphism
              (K := fun j ↦ ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor.{u, u} l E T).obj
                (P, Q)).obj (op j))
              (integralOperationsTowerStep
                ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor.{u, u} l E T).obj (P, Q))))).v
                  i (i - 1) (by omega) = 0
